description: This file defines a custom exception class FixedDepositProductNotFoundException used in the savings portfolio module of the Apache Fineract project. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors for handling cases where a fixed deposit product cannot be found by ID.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductNotFoundException
classes.description: A specific exception thrown when a fixed deposit product with a given ID does not exist in the system. It extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException to integrate with the platform's error handling framework.

methods.name: FixedDepositProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the ID was invalid.

methods.name: FixedDepositProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the ID was invalid and includes the root cause exception.
